justification: HOLY COW folks, lineup card's set and lemme tell ya why! Jordy Love is riding shotgun again at quarterback -- the man slung THIRTY-SIX points last week for thirteen lousy bucks, and you don't pull a hot arm outta the rotation two weeks after you were still bragging about him in print, that's just bad manners, Aaron Rodgers can keep warmin' the bullpen bench, future Hall of Famer or not! Bijan's rollin' at running back, Aaron Jones holds down the other spot, and Zay Flowers has been quiet two weeks runnin' now but any day now, folks, ANY day, he busts one wide open, stickin' with him through the cold snap. Big change up front: T.J. Hockenson's tagged OUT up in Minnesota, so Hunter Henry trots in at tight end -- no hard feelings pal, you were a fine fella to have around, but we need somebody who can actually suit up Sunday! D'Andre Swift, my Chicago guy, has got no ballgame this week so he sits one out, we'll see him soon, champ. Isaiah Likely and Stefon Diggs already locked in their numbers from the early window, and Boswell and the Ravens D round out the card same as always. Let's play ball!
